issues.problem: The two titles name opposite actions: ZH has 脱帽的人 (the one(s) who removed their hats, i.e. Congress answering by uncovering), while EN has 'the Men Who Kept Their Hats On' — keeping hats on, which is the opposite gesture and not what the ZH title says.
issues.suggestion: Change the EN title to match the ZH: 'The Man Who Bowed and the Men Who Took Their Hats Off: Handing Back Power, 1783' (or, if the EN is intended, change ZH 脱帽的人 to 戴着帽子的人).

issues.problem: The EN adds a verbatim journal quotation ('the President, after a pause, informed him...') and the interpretive line that the President 'did not rush to fill the silence', neither of which appears in the ZH; the shared content (the pause is in the record) matches.
issues.suggestion: Either add the journal quotation and the 'did not rush' sentence to the ZH, or drop them from the EN so both versions carry the same material.

overall: The two editions match closely on all facts, names, dates and quotations apart from the title's reversed hat gesture (remove vs keep on) and one extra quotation and interpretive aside in the EN of sections.story.1.
